The deliverable gives 365 days and 13 April 2027 (not 1 May 2027), and calculates 365 days remaining from 13 April 2026 (not 383 days). The values are wrong: 1 May 2026 + 365 days = 1 May 2027, and from 13 April 2026 to 1 May 2027 is 383 days.
